title: Unveiling the antiviral inhibitory activity of ebselen and ebsulfur derivatives on SARS-CoV-2 using machine learning-bas

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The equation is written as "pIC₅₀ = (1 / IC₅₀ (M))", but pIC50 is defined as -log10(IC50 in molar). The reciprocal of an IC50 in molar has units of inverse molar and is not a pIC50 value.

The paper defines R² = Σ(y_pred - y_bar)² / Σ(y_exp - y_bar)². This is not the general definition of R². The standard coefficient of determination is R² = 1 - Σ(y_exp - y_pred)² / Σ(y_exp - y_bar)². The formula as written can exceed 1 and does not match residual-based R² for the reported RF/ANN models.

The abstract reports training R² values of 0.83 (MLR), 0.82 (RF), and 0.92 (ANN), and test RMSE values of 0.27, 0.18, and 0.09. The results section states MLR training R² = 0.69 and test RMSE = 0.56, ANN training R² = 0.89 and test RMSE = 0.05. These are contradictory statistics for the same models.

The methods text says RF hyperparameters include Max feature, Min_sample_leaf, Min_samples_split, and number of estimators. The results report a selected "max feature of 4" and also "max depth of 10." Table 1(a), however, lists n_estimators, Max depth, Min samples split, and Min samples leaf, omitting Max feature. Thus the table does not contain one of the hyperparameters reported as optimized.

The methods text states that five ANN hyperparameters are examined, including maximum number of iterations (max_iter). Table 1(b) lists only four hyperparameters: number of hidden layers, number of neurons, learning rate, and batch size. Max_iter is missing, making the hyperparameter search description inconsistent with the table.

predicted_errors.error_location: LB-PaCS-MD results / discussion of P8 binding
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The text first says P8 orients "the Se of the benzoselenazole moiety toward the S of C145," but then states "chalcogen-bonding interaction between S atoms in P8 and C145." If P8 contains the specified Se atom, the interaction should be described as Se(8)···S(C145), not between two S atoms. The two statements conflict.

The methods state "Seven ebselen analogs were tested against four strains of SARS-CoV-2 M^Pro" and later "All experiments with live SARS-CoV-2 M^Pro were performed..." M^Pro is an enzyme, not a live virus or a strain. The efficacy assay is described as using live SARS-CoV-2 in Vero E6 cells, so the text confuses the viral protease with the virus/strain and additionally mentions four strains while only one strain (B.1.617.2) is specified.
